name: Select
description:
Pick one option from a short, known list. The trigger is a field box (fa-control) that
shows the chosen option's icon and label; the list opens on glass below it, at least as
wide as the trigger, with a ✓ on the current option. Use Combobox when the list is long
enough to need typing.
signature: <V extends string = string>({ options, value, defaultValue, onValueChange, placeholder, size, width, icon, disabled, readOnly, required, invalid, name, id, onBlur, onOpenChange, className, ref, ...aria }: SelectProps<V>): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name when a visible label does not name the control.

props.name: aria-labelledby
props.description: IDs of elements that provide the accessible name.

props.name: className
props.description: Layout only. Applied to the trigger.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The initial value when using the component without controlling its state.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables interaction while retaining the component’s disabled appearance.

props.name: icon
props.description: A fixed leading icon, for options that have none of their own.

props.name: id
props.description: A stable element or component identifier.

props.name: invalid
props.description: Invalid outside a Field.

props.name: name
props.description: The component’s name or native form field name, as specified by its value type.

props.name: onBlur
props.description: Fires when focus leaves the select while it is closed (not when its popup opens).

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called when open change occurs. The callback type specifies its arguments.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called when value change occurs. The callback type specifies its arguments.

props.name: options
props.description: The available choices, including their values and visible labels.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Shown while nothing is chosen. Name the choice ("Choose an environment"), not "Select…".

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Displays the current value without allowing edits.

props.name: ref
props.description: Receives the underlying element for focus or measurement. React 19 accepts ref as a normal prop.

props.name: required
props.description: Marks the field as required; pair it with the corresponding schema validation.

props.name: size
props.description: The token-based size. Touch targets adapt to coarse pointers independently of the selected density.

props.name: value
props.description: The controlled value. Keep it in application state and update it in the change callback.

props.name: width
props.description: Content width: short (port, PIN), medium (name, hostname), full (default).
